A '''Bocohn medtext hardbook''' was a type of rare and valuable [[Book/Legends|book]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a Bocohn medtext hardbook was among a collection of valuable artifacts that the financier [[Veilred Jydor]] kept in [[Gender/Legends|his]] penthouse in the [[High Card Casino]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Danteel]].
